prompt: What should you do with the gaps before fitting `HistGradientBoostingClassifier`?
hint: It handles them at each split.

choices.text: Leave them
choices.why: Yes. It learns which side the missing values go to.

choices.text: Fill them with −1
choices.why: That throws away what the tree would learn from the gap.

choices.text: Fill them with the median of all the rows
choices.why: All rows is the preparation leak, and the fill is not needed.

choices.text: Delete every row that has a gap in either of the two columns
choices.why: That drops a quarter of the subscribers and the information in the gap.

prompt: Why is target encoding the encoder most likely to leak?
hint: What goes into each row's value?

choices.text: It uses the test months
choices.why: Not if fitted correctly; the problem is inside the training rows.

choices.text: It creates thousands of columns
choices.why: It creates one.

choices.text: Each row's own label is inside the average it gets
choices.why: Yes. `TargetEncoder` computes it from the other folds.

choices.text: It sorts values alphabetically
choices.why: That is `OrdinalEncoder` without `categories`.
